plan.notes: Source: Zane State College Academic Catalog 2022-2023 (zanestate.edu), 'Curriculum for Electrical/Electronics Engineering Technology'. Catalog-year honesty: this is the 2022-2023 catalog, the most recent official Zane State catalog with a cleanly extractable program sequence (the 2024-2025 per-program Course of Study PDFs have a jumbled multi-column layout that does not reliably map courses to terms). Credit sums verified: 15+15+17+15 = 62, matching the catalog's 'ASSOCIATE OF APPLIED SCIENCE DEGREE (62 credit hours)'. Elective lists are printed in the catalog and transcribed into choice notes. No TCCNS in Ohio; transfer_confidence is empty.
